FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Brewed Awakening Coffee House operates as a cozy coffee shop offering a diverse selection of brewed beverages, teas, and light snacks such as pastries and sandwiches. Our establishment is designed to create a welcoming environment with seating for up to 150 patrons, ensuring a comfortable experience for all customers. We adhere to strict fire safety protocols and maintain our premises in pristine condition to prevent any safety hazards. Our operation is continuous with no closures exceeding 30 consecutive days, which supports consistent service for our loyal clientele. Importantly, we do not serve alcohol or provide live entertainment, as this helps us maintain a focus on quality coffee and community engagement while lowering potential liability risks. Our staff is trained in food safety, and we source our ingredients from reputable local suppliers to ensure high quality and freshness. We actively manage inventory to minimize waste, maintaining a commitment to sustainability and efficiency in our operations.

Our coffee shop and tea house offers a spacious environment for customers to enjoy their drinks and pastries, featuring a total floor area of 9,000 square feet, complete with cozy seating areas and a community space for events and gatherings.
